variants.briefing:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, [TargetName], was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to [Location] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
